# Components

<!-- Generated by `python3 lib/setup/engine.py docs > docs/components.md` from setup/components/*.toml; tests/unit/test_docs.py checks it's current. Edit the component files, not this. -->

Every app or feature is a component (`setup/components/<id>.toml`). Choose them with a preset and `./homelab setup --plan/--apply`, the setup app, or an assistant (docs/getting-started.md). What one needs comes along by itself.

Presets: **everything** (37 components); **family** (35 components); **minimal** (5 components).

## Always there

### Core: sign-in, home page, HTTPS (`core`)

Caddy (HTTPS on your mesh address), Authentik (one sign-in with passkeys and MFA), the home page and its admin sheets.

- always on
- needs `mesh`
- goes well with `backups`, `public-access`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos
- containers `caddy`, `authentik-db`, `authentik-server`, `authentik-worker`, `ops`
- public at `home.<domain>`, `auth.<domain>`
- jobs `notify`, `drift`, `storage-report`, `ops`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `DOMAIN` | needed | Your domain, no subdomain (the sites become home.<domain>, auth.<domain>, …) |
| `DOMAIN_ALIAS` | needed | A second domain serving the same sites (DOMAIN stays the canonical one) |
| `NETBIRD_IP` | needed | This machine's mesh (NetBird) address: ip -4 -o addr show wt0 |
| `HOST_UID` | default `1000` | Your user's id (id -u): files the apps write belong to you |
| `HOST_GID` | default `1000` | Your user's group id (id -g) |
| `ADMIN_USER` | needed | Your login on this machine, also your admin username in Authentik (lowercase) |
| `ADMIN_LOGIN` | optional | Your username in Authentik exactly as written there (capitals matter); empty = ADMIN_USER |
| `ADMIN_NAME` | needed | Your name, as the sign-in pages and mails show it |
| `NOTIFY_TO` | needed | Where the homelab's own mails go: failed jobs, drift, the outside heartbeat |
| `BRAND` | default `Home` | How pages, mails and apps name this homelab (e.g. Smith) |
| `BRAND_SLUG` | default `home` | The same as a short lowercase id (e.g. smith); keep it once set |
| `SIGNIN_TITLE` | default `Sign in to Home` | Title of the sign-in page |
| `PHONE_EXAMPLE` | default `+44 7700 900123` | Example phone number on the sign-up form |
| `HOME_COUNTRY` | default `GB` | Two-letter country code: admin sign-ins from elsewhere mail the admins |
| `HOME_COUNTRY_NAME` | default `the United Kingdom` | That country's name, for the alert mail |
| `BRANDING_DIR` | default `branding/default` | Logos and icons: branding/default or your own copy (branding/README.md) |
| `TIME_ZONE` | default `Europe/Zurich` | The containers' time zone (e.g. Europe/Zurich, America/New_York) |
| `AUTHENTIK_TAG` | default `2026.8.3` | Authentik's version (pinned; diff the upstream compose.yml before raising it) |
| `AK_SECRET_KEY` | secret, generated | Authentik's secret key |
| `AK_PG_PASS` | secret, generated | Authentik's database password |
| `INFOMANIAK_API_TOKEN` | secret, asked | DNS API token for Let's Encrypt (scopes domain:read dns:read dns:write; only _acme-challenge records) |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__HOST` | default `smtp.protonmail.ch` | Mail server for sign-up, password reset and alerts |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__PORT` | default `587` | Its port |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__USE_TLS` | default `true` | STARTTLS |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__USE_SSL` | default `false` | TLS from the start (port 465) |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__USERNAME` | needed | Mail account (also the sender) |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__PASSWORD` | secret, asked | Its SMTP password or token |
| `AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__FROM` | optional | Sender name and address, e.g. "Smith <noreply@example.org>" |

### Mesh network (NetBird) (`mesh`)

Your devices reach this machine over WireGuard; nothing listens on the internet or the LAN.

- always on
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `NETBIRD_PEER` | default `homelab` | This machine's peer name in the NetBird dashboard |
| `LAN_ALLOW` | optional | What the LAN may reach on this machine itself besides DHCPv6, mDNS and NetBird: firewalld services or PORT/PROTO, spaces between (e.g. samba-client transmission-client); the homelab answers only over NetBird |

## Getting in

### Public access (`public-access`)

Family members reach the apps from anywhere, through NetBird's reverse proxy in TLS passthrough mode, behind Authentik with MFA. No port opens on your router.

- needs `core`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `NETBIRD_PROXY_CLUSTER` | optional | NetBird reverse proxy cluster target for the wildcard CNAMEs (Custom Domains) |
| `NETBIRD_PROXY_PORT` | default `9443` | Listen port the NetBird TLS services got (9443 on the shared eu1 cluster) |

### SSH with your sign-in (`ssh-sso`)

SSH into this machine with the key in your Authentik profile plus password and authenticator code; admins only, mesh only.

- needs `core`
- runs on fedora
- containers `authentik-ldap-ssh`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `SSH_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD` | secret, asked | Password of SSSD's bind user (written by authentik/setup-ssh.sh) |
| `AK_LDAP_SSH_OUTPOST_TOKEN` | secret, asked | Token of the Authentik outpost "ldap-ssh" (written by authentik/setup-ssh.sh) |

### Terminal in the browser (Termix) (`terminal`)

An SSH client in the browser for admins, mesh only; it still needs the SSH key and code.

- needs `core`, `ssh-sso`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch
- containers `termix`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `TERMIX_TAG` | default `26.10.5` | Termix version |
| `TERMIX_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | secret, generated | Termix's Authentik client secret |

## Apps

### Documents (Paperless-ngx) (`paperless`)

Scan, OCR and find every letter and bill; sign-in through Authentik.

- needs `core`
- goes well with `local-ai`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos
- containers `paperless`, `paperless-redis`, `paperless-gotenberg`, `paperless-tika`
- public at `paperless.<domain>`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `PAPERLESS_TAG` | default `3.3.0` | Paperless-ngx version |
| `PAPERLESS_GOTENBERG_TAG` | default `8.37.0` | Gotenberg version (Office files and e-mails into PDFs); keep the one Paperless' own compose file names |
| `PAPERLESS_TIKA_TAG` | default `3.3.1.0` | Apache Tika version (the text of Office files and e-mails); keep the one Paperless' own compose file names |
| `PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY` | secret, generated | Paperless's secret key |
| `PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER` | default `admin` | Local break-glass admin of Paperless |
| `PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | secret, generated | Its password |
| `PAPERLESS_OIDC_JSON` | secret, asked | Paperless's Authentik client (written by the wizard) |
| `PAPERLESS_SSO_ONLY` | default `false` | Only Authentik sign-in (after linking your account) |
| `OCR_LANGUAGES` | default `deu+fra+eng` | OCR languages, Tesseract codes joined with + (deu, fra, eng, ita, spa, …) |

### Local AI (Ollama) (`local-ai`)

Titles, tags and search for Documents, tags for Bookmarks, on your own graphics card; nothing leaves the machine.

- needs `core`
- an NVIDIA card (macOS: the Apple GPU)
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos
- containers `ollama`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `OLLAMA_URL` | optional | Where the apps reach Ollama: empty = the ollama container here; macOS: Ollama itself (Homebrew, Metal) |
| `OLLAMA_TAG` | default `0.40.7` | Ollama version |
| `PAPERLESS_AI_MODEL` | default `gemma4:12b` | Model for Paperless (pull it first: docker compose exec ollama ollama pull <model>) |
| `PAPERLESS_AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | default `bge-m3` | Embedding model for Paperless's search |

### Downloads through a VPN (qBittorrent, Prowlarr) (`downloads`)

Torrents and their search sites only through a VPN with a kill switch (gluetun; Proton's forwarded port); admins, mesh only. Needs a VPN subscription.

- needs `core`, `media-library`
- goes well with `movies-tv`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch
- containers `gluetun`, `qbittorrent`, `prowlarr`
- jobs `downloads-guard`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER` | default `protonvpn` | The VPN provider, as gluetun names it (protonvpn, mullvad, …) |
| `VPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY` | secret, asked | The VPN's WireGuard private key (Proton: a WireGuard configuration with NAT-PMP) |
| `VPN_SERVER_COUNTRIES` | optional | VPN server countries, commas between (empty: any) |
| `DOWNLOADS_PORT_FORWARDING` | default `true` | The VPN's forwarded port for incoming peers (Proton: P2P servers); false for a provider without it |
| `DOWNLOADS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | secret, asked | The password of qBittorrent's, Prowlarr's, Radarr's and Sonarr's own logins (after Authentik) |
| `DOWNLOADS_SEED_RATIO` | default `2` | Seed each torrent to this ratio (or the days below), then stop it |
| `DOWNLOADS_SEED_DAYS` | default `14` | Seed each torrent this many days at most |
| `DOWNLOADS_KEEP_FREE_PCT` | default `15` | Stop all torrents when the media folder's disk has less than this % free |
| `GLUETUN_TAG` | default `v3.41.3` | gluetun (VPN) version |
| `QBITTORRENT_TAG` | default `5.3.0-2` | qBittorrent version |
| `PROWLARR_TAG` | default `2.7.0.5723-ls167` | Prowlarr version (LinuxServer's image) |
| `GLUETUN_CONTROL_KEY` | secret, generated | API key of gluetun's control server (exit address, forwarded port) for the checks |
| `QBITTORRENT_API_KEY` | secret, generated | qBittorrent's API key (Radarr, Sonarr, the VPN's port hook) |
| `PROWLARR_API_KEY` | secret, generated | Prowlarr's API key |

### Movies and TV on request (Radarr, Sonarr) (`movies-tv`)

Ask for a film or a series and it arrives in Movies or TV Shows (through Downloads); nothing downloads unless someone asks. Admins, mesh only.

- needs `downloads`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch
- containers `radarr`, `sonarr`, `recyclarr`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `RADARR_TAG` | default `6.4.4.10685-ls325` | Radarr version (LinuxServer's image) |
| `SONARR_TAG` | default `4.0.20.3014-ls3` | Sonarr version (LinuxServer's image) |
| `RECYCLARR_TAG` | default `8.8.1` | Recyclarr version |
| `RADARR_API_KEY` | secret, generated | Radarr's API key |
| `SONARR_API_KEY` | secret, generated | Sonarr's API key |

## Disks

### Second disk for photos and files (`second-disk`)

A dedicated NVMe (XFS with reflinks) for the photo library and the files; the wizard formats it.

- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `PHOTOS_DISK` | needed | The disk's stable name: ls -l /dev/disk/by-id/ / grep -v part (it gets wiped) |
| `PHOTOS_UUID` | optional | Its filesystem UUID (written by the wizard after formatting) |
| `NVME1_DIR` | default `/srv/nvme1` | Where the disk is mounted |

## Backups

### Encrypted backups (`backups`)

Hourly and after every change: every app's data, encrypted to a key that never lives on this machine.

- needs `core`
- goes well with `offsite`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos
- jobs `backup`, `backup-watch`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT` | needed | The age PUBLIC key (age1…) from age-keygen on your laptop; the private key stays there |

### Off-site copy (Proton Drive) (`offsite`)

Nightly: the encrypted backups, photos and files to Proton Drive, a restore test every Sunday.

- needs `backups`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch
- jobs `photos-backup`, `offbox`, `proton-drive-update`

### Outside heartbeat (`heartbeat`)

Every 5 minutes a check from the internet's side (healthchecks.io): a mail when the machine goes quiet.

- needs `core`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch, macos
- jobs `heartbeat`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `HEARTBEAT_URL` | secret, asked | Ping URL of a healthchecks.io check (period 5 min, grace 15 min) |
| `HEARTBEAT_API_KEY_RO` | secret, asked | Read-only API key of that project (the home page shows its view) |

## Home

### Smart home (Home Assistant + Matter) (`home-assistant`)

Home Assistant with its own login and TOTP, mesh only; Matter devices on the LAN.

- needs `core`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch
- containers `homeassistant`, `matter-server`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `HA_TAG` | default `2026.10.4` | Home Assistant version |
| `MATTER_TAG` | default `1.5.5` | Matter server version |

### Ad blocking (AdGuard Home) (`adblock`)

DNS with ad and tracker blocking for every mesh device; admin page for admins, mesh only.

- needs `core`
- runs on fedora, debian, ubuntu, arch
- containers `adguard`

| Setting | | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ADGUARD_TAG` | default `v0.107.79` | AdGuard Home version |
